items.text: **The fly-out's Mixer button is round.** A finger-size circle that sits in the fly-out's rounded bottom, the same distance from its edge all the way round; it had been stretched into an oval.
**The volume fly-out's Mixer button is an icon.** Three faders at different heights; it still says "Mixer" to a screen reader and on hover.
**The volume ring's yellow is the grid button's yellow.** It had been drawn 15% brighter than the accent colour.
**The volume arrows are the same grey as the unlit notches.**
**The volume arrows line up with the end notches without touching them.** Each arrow sits right under (or over) the top and bottom notch, with a small gap.

**The volume ring now sits inside the bar at every size.** It is placed from the bar itself: its centre is the centre of the bar's round end, it is the grid ring's size, and its gap to the bar's edge equals the grid ring's gap to the top and bottom. At the Small size setting it had stuck out past the bar's end. The speaker sits on the same centre, and the up and down arrows' tips now meet the ends of the top and bottom notches.

**The volume ring is now the size of the grid ring.** It is drawn as the same 40 px circle as the grid button's ring, centred on the round end of the bar, so it keeps the same gap to the bar's edge as the grid ring does to its top and bottom. On an iPhone it had drawn at about half that size.

**The volume ring has notches, and the speaker sits at its centre.** Eleven notches, one every 10%, run along the ring's inside and light up to the level. The ring, the speaker and the round end of the bar now share one centre: the speaker had sat 3 px left of it.
